lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots organized into approximately 10-12 vertical columns along the visible lateral flank from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal rows of circular spots to form a series of grid-like anchor nodes in a rectangular pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high luminance on top, shadow below) running parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs scattered within its silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of at least four remoras (Echeneidae) is attached to the ventral-lateral surface directly below the gill region.
